info.description: Deposit ONE pre-signed, hard-capped, expiring EIP-3009 payment payload (or a price ladder of up to 8) plus trigger conditions. HoldFire watches the seller and fires your own payload the moment conditions hold (seller price <= your cap, endpoint healthy, before your deadline), then publishes hash-chained, Ed25519-signed proof of execution-or-expiry. We never sign anything, never hold keys, never touch funds: settlement runs buyer->seller via the seller's facilitator. Our fee is a separate buyer-signed micro-authorization ($0.001 + 1%, capped $0.02) charged only on fired intents. Revocation: instant registry halt + payload shredding, and finality via USDC cancelAuthorization which the token contract enforces against everyone, including us. Launch caps: <= $10/intent, <= 72h validity, exposure printed on every receipt.
info.title: HoldFire — conditional executor for pre-signed x402 payment intents

fee_payload.description: One EIP-3009 authorization to the HoldFire fee address, value = fee(cap). Required for armed intents.

manifest_signature.description: EIP-191 signature by buyer over the canonical intent object (sorted-keys JSON of buyer, seller_url, method, max_price_micro, deadline, healthy_k, stable_polls, require_healthy, pay_to, payment_digests sorted, fee_digest). Payload digest = sha256 of canonical {authorization, signature}.

payment_payloads.description: Price ladder of x402 exact-scheme EIP-3009 payloads: {authorization:{from,to,value,validAfter,validBefore,nonce}, signature}. Omit for watch-only.
